responsibility: Implements the mutable compilation context object that threads backend state through Rust HIR lowering. It bootstraps compilation of builtin types, defines the hash used to canonicalize compiled GCC types, and manages closure capture scopes and bindings, complementing the context header’s declaration maps and stacks with the runtime logic that initializes and maintains them during code generation.
same_name_distinction: Provides the runtime behavior of the compilation context declared in the header, notably builtin-type bootstrapping, structural type hashing, and closure-scope push/pop and binding lookup maintenance. Unlike the header, it does not define the overall context data layout and public state-carrying API; it implements selected operational methods of that context.
